name: mcv
description: mcv (Multi-session Coordination Vantage): run several Claude Code sessions on one project while you talk to one. Requires the herdr terminal manager.

plugins.name: mcv
plugins.description: Early: in daily use on two projects, by one person. Run several Claude Code sessions on one project while you talk to one: a coordinator session starts worker sessions, each in its own git worktree, and passes their questions and results to you. Requires the herdr terminal manager.
